scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none
scales.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight leading-tight

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: High density for data (Control Room Grid), generous spacing for profile selection. Aggressive asymmetry.

grid_modes.main_dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
grid_modes.hero_profiles: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8. Large immersive cards.

spacing_and_layout.containers: Sharp edges, border-collapse style layouts. Paddings must be generous inside bordered containers (p-6 or p-8).

surfaces_and_micro_themes.interactive_card: bg-[#121212] border border-zinc-800 rounded-none hover:border-[#007AFF] hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] transition-colors duration-200
surfaces_and_micro_themes.tactical_button: bg-transparent border border-[#007AFF] text-[#007AFF] hover:bg-[#007AFF] hover:text-white uppercase tracking-widest font-bold rounded-none px-6 py-3 transition-all
surfaces_and_micro_themes.primary_button: bg-[#007AFF] text-white border border-[#007AFF] hover:bg-[#005bb5] uppercase tracking-widest font-bold rounded-none px-6 py-3 transition-all

components.navigation: Sticky top glass panel (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-zinc-800). Must include Logo, Profile status, and System Restore CTA.

shadcn_overrides.card: Remove all rounded corners (rounded-none). Use stark borders.
shadcn_overrides.button: Remove all rounded corners. Add uppercase and tracking-widest to text.
shadcn_overrides.progress: Remove rounded corners. Background zinc-900, indicator uses accent colors (Volt Blue or Electric Blaze).
shadcn_overrides.table: Sharp borders. border-b border-zinc-800. Header text uses overline typography.
shadcn_overrides.tabs: Border-bottom style instead of pill style. Active tab has 2px solid bottom border in primary color.

components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. Preferred weight: regular or bold for tactical feel.

animations.hover: Instant color swaps, subtle 1px border highlights.
animations.transitions: transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
animations.loading: Terminal-style blinking cursor or sharp indeterminate progress bar.

dashboard_home.layout: Grid Mode A for Profile Selection, followed by Grid Mode B for System Monitoring.
dashboard_home.profile_cards: 3 large cards. Gaming (Red accent hover), Office (White accent hover), Optimal (Blue accent hover).
dashboard_home.system_metrics: Tactical gauges or sharp progress bars for CPU, RAM, Disk. Real-time updates.

driver_management.layout: 2-column split. Left: Hardware HUD. Right: Data table.
driver_management.hardware_hud: Absolute positioned text labels over the motherboard image, simulating a high-tech scan.
driver_management.driver_table: Dense data table. Checkboxes for batch updates. Sticky bottom bar for 'Update Selected' action with warning modal.

ai_assistant.styling: Monospace font for AI text. Typewriter effect for incoming recommendations. Deep black background with green or blue text accents for 'Apto' (Compatible) or 'No Apto' (Not Compatible).

image_urls.description: High-tech close up of a computer motherboard.
image_urls.usage: Use as the background for the Hardware Detection visual validation in the Driver Management module. Apply a heavy dark overlay (bg-black/60) so HUD text is readable on top.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Theme and Archetype 2 (Performance Pro) guidelines. No soft/rounded UI.
Ensure all fonts (Barlow Condensed, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono) are imported in the global CSS or index.html.
Do NOT use pure #000000 for backgrounds unless specified; use the designated #0A0A0A base.
Implement the System Restore Point creation as a highly visible, tactical button (e.g., top right header).
Use Phosphor icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for all iconography.
For the Driver Management section, use the provided Unsplash image as the hardware visual, overlaid with analytical data points.
Customize Shadcn components heavily to remove rounded corners and apply the tactical borders.
Ensure the AI Assistant uses the mono font and terminal aesthetic.
